name: Eye of Mugg
summary: Krom'rosh sends you into Krol'dok Stronghold as the Twilight cult's foothold proves larger than expected. He asks for proof that their leader is dead.

sections.title: Krol'dok Stronghold
sections.body: Krom'rosh fears more allies will be sacrificed if the Twilight cult keeps ravaging these lands. Few who entered the cave survived, and the cult's foothold is larger than he believed. Now you are to enter Krol'dok Stronghold and return with proof of the leader's death.

faq.q: Who is asking me to enter Krol'dok Stronghold?
faq.answer: Krom'rosh sends you into Krol'dok Stronghold to bring back proof that the Twilight cult's leader is dead.

faq.q: What is wrong at the stronghold?
faq.answer: The Twilight cult has a larger foothold than Krom'rosh expected and has been ravaging the lands and sacrificing allies.

faq.q: Why does Krom'rosh want me to go in?
faq.answer: Krom'rosh wants the cult stopped before it can continue ravaging the lands and sacrificing allies.

faq.q: What proof does Krom'rosh ask for?
faq.answer: He asks for proof that the Twilight cult's leader is dead.

faq.q: Did many who entered the cave survive?
faq.answer: Few who managed to enter the cave survived.

attribution: In-game quest text: Eye of Mugg
